variants.label: Лаванда + лайм
variants.prompt:
Edit the reference of the original friendly pixel-art desktop companion BIPYCH. Explore a new colorway and slightly different body proportions of the SAME mascot family. Keep the recognizable stepped outline, an integrated plain face with two widely separated simple rectangular eyes and no mouth, two tiny block hands, two tiny feet, two little flank accent pixels, and exactly one small square satellite pixel floating by a matching notch near the upper-right corner. No separate screen panel, ears, tail, antenna, clothes, fur, math symbols, numbers, belly badge or circular gauge. Calm, playful, slightly deadpan technology pet suitable for ages 10–16.
Pixel art with a coarse consistent square grid, crisp intentional stepped edges, strong silhouette, limited palette with 2–3 flat stepped shading tones. No blur, metallic shine, toy plastic, gradients or furry texture.
Presentation: one LARGE full-body three-quarter character on the left, two SMALL versions on the right with identical palette and proportions: curious tilt above, joyous arched pixel eyes below. Exactly one satellite pixel for EACH figure. All parts inside frame. Plain warm off-white backdrop, restrained pixel ground shadows, generous whitespace. No labels, text, numbers, logos, palette swatches, scenery or watermark. Palette: soft lavender body #CBB9F0, aubergine outline and eyes #573C78, violet shading #A68AD3, vivid lime-yellow accents and satellite #DDF36B. Lavender must dominate, no mint and no blue body. Shape: taller-than-wide stepped rectangle, short asymmetrical block hands, narrow square feet; one eye one pixel higher to create an inquisitive witty look. Clearly visibly taller than the reference while keeping its recognizable rounded pixel corners.
